headword: {集合場所|しゅうごうばしょ}

definitions.explanation: meeting place; assembly point; the designated location where people gather before an activity

examples.japanese: {集合場所|しゅうごうばしょ}は{駅前|えきまえ}です。
examples.english: The meeting place is in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {集合場所|しゅうごうばしょ}と{時間|じかん}を{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: Please confirm the meeting place and time.

examples.japanese: {避難|ひなん}の{集合場所|しゅうごうばしょ}は{校庭|こうてい}に{決|き}まっている。
examples.english: The evacuation assembly point is set as the school grounds.

notes:
{集合場所|しゅうごうばしょ} is a compound noun combining {集合|しゅうごう} (assembly, gathering) + {場所|ばしょ} (place). It's used for any designated meeting point.

COMMON CONTEXTS:
- {遠足|えんそく}や{修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう} (field trips and school trips)
- ツアー (guided tours)
- {避難訓練|ひなんくんれん} (evacuation drills)
- グループ{活動|かつどう} (group activities)
- イベント (events)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {集合場所|しゅうごうばしょ}に{集|あつ}まる (to gather at the meeting place)
- {集合場所|しゅうごうばしょ}を{決|き}める (to decide the meeting place)
- {集合場所|しゅうごうばしょ}に{遅|おく}れる (to be late to the meeting place)

RELATED TERMS:
- {待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ{場所|ばしょ} (meeting/rendezvous spot - more casual)
- {集合|しゅうごう}{時間|じかん} (assembly time)
- {避難|ひなん}{場所|ばしょ} (evacuation site)

REGISTER: Neutral. Standard vocabulary for organized activities.
